snippet.title: Kingdom Come Deliverance II - Mysteria Ecclesiae DLC Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Something sinister is afoot at Sedletz Monastery. Mysteria Ecclesiae, the third story DLC for Kingdom Come: Deliverance II, is coming 11 November 2025.
 
Step into Henry's most haunting investigation yet. Question the brothers, follow the clues, and uncover the source of a deadly outbreak before it's too late.
